pages.title: Rummy Classic
pages.creator: Playades International LLC
pages.description: Build sets and runs in Rummy Classic and try to empty your hand before the computer opponents do. The winner of each round scores the value of the cards the others still hold. Keep playing rounds until someone reaches 200 points.

pages.title: Farm vs Zombies
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Grow mutant plants to defend your homestead in Farm vs Zombies. Harvest resources while the undead approach and decide where to put your defenses. Keep the farm producing what you need so you can hold off the next attack.

pages.title: Theo Morini's Magical Resort
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rebuild a resort on an enchanted island in Theo Morini's Magical Resort. Combine items in the merge puzzles and follow Theo's story as work on the resort progresses. Meet the other characters as the island and its relationships take shape.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble shuffled images in Italian Brainrot Drag Merge Puzzle. Correctly aligned neighbors join into a cluster you can move together. Drag a piece or cluster onto another to swap positions, and work through layouts ranging from three by three to six by six.

pages.title: Hair Salon: Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Wash and style customers' hair in Hair Salon: Beauty Salon. Work through each makeover, then choose jewelry or makeup to finish the look. Try a different combination as each customer takes a turn in the salon chair.

pages.title: Atomic Merge 2048
pages.creator: Tejas Shrimali
pages.description: Drop numbered blocks toward the center in Atomic Merge 2048. Bring identical values together to make bigger numbers and work toward 2048. Keep the pile inside the red orbit by checking where each piece is likely to land.

pages.title: Malatang Master Stack Run 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Build a skewer as you run in Malatang Master Stack Run 3D. Slide across the course to pick up noodles, chicken thighs, chili, and other ingredients. Look ahead to choose a route that adds more to the stack before you reach the finish.

pages.title: Jetpack Jump
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Send an athlete as far as you can in Jetpack Jump. Time the takeoff and use the jetpack to extend the jump. Spend the coins from each attempt on upgrades and see whether you can improve your distance.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car Stunts
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Drive down elevated ramps in Mega Ramp Car Stunts. Build speed for jumps and try flips while the car is in the air. Line up the landing so you can stay on the track and reach the next stunt.

pages.title: Headless Joe
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help a robot put his head back on in Headless Joe. Solve puzzles and collect the bolts Joe needs to secure it. Look at what each layout gives you and work out how to reach the bolts you still need.

pages.title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Climb colored platforms in Obby Tower Parkour Climb. Pick an easy, medium, or hard tower and aim for the finish platform. Play Normal or Challenge mode on your own, or bring in a second player to compete or compare times.

pages.title: Stickman: Dinosaur arena
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Lead a squad of dinosaurs into battle in Stickman: Dinosaur arena. Add new creatures to the lineup and upgrade the ones you already have. See how your stronger squad fares as you try to make it farther into the arena.

pages.title: Hide and Build a Bridge!
pages.creator: Endless Games
pages.description: Gather blocks for a bridge to the portal in Hide and Build a Bridge! Watch for the seeker while you carry blocks back to the crossing. The seeker can catch runners or break bridges, so look for a safe time to build.

pages.title: My Little Farm
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Plant crops, harvest them, and sell the produce in My Little Farm. Check what customers need each day and decide what to grow next. Put some of the earnings into better tools to help keep up with new requests.

pages.title: Restaurant VIP Masterchef
pages.creator: RBIN
pages.description: Run a dining room in Restaurant VIP Masterchef. Look after diners and keep service moving so you can reach the day's target. Work through more shifts and see how high a score you can build while managing the restaurant.

pages.title: My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together spring looks for Ellie and her friends in My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look. Browse the wardrobe for pieces that suit the floral theme. Try different combinations to give each friend her own outfit for the season.

pages.title: Build Your Aquarium
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Dive for fish and bring them back to the aquarium in Build Your Aquarium. Stock the tanks with different kinds of fish to meet customers' needs. Unlock more tanks and expand the aquarium as you bring in more visitors.

pages.title: Stolen House
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Take the requested items and slip out unseen in Stolen House. Watch for traps and obstacles on the way to the loot, then find a path past the guards. The layout changes as you unlock more levels.

pages.title: Drift Challenge Turbo Racer
pages.creator: Rising Pixel
pages.description: Steer through rally courses in Drift Challenge Turbo Racer. The car accelerates on its own, so focus on timing your drifts and using the three-button controls. Unlock more cars and compare your runs on the leaderboard.

pages.title: BFFs Black Friday Collection
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Pick clothes and hairstyles for the friends in BFFs Black Friday Collection. Try the new pieces in their wardrobes and see how each hairstyle changes the outfit. Give each friend a look for the Black Friday outing.

pages.title: 3D Car Simulator
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Choose a police car, a race car, or a vintage car in 3D Car Simulator. Take your pick onto one of three maps and get a feel for how it drives. Switch cars or maps when you want to try another route.

pages.title: Parking Way
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Find a way out of crowded parking lots in Parking Way. Look at the space between your vehicle and the obstacles, then work out a route to the exit. Pay attention to tight turns before you move.

pages.title: Stickman Ninja Way of the Shinobi
pages.creator: FantasyWorldStd
pages.description: Fight the invaders in Stickman Ninja Way of the Shinobi. Use quick strikes and combos when you have an opening, then roll to avoid attacks. Upgrade the ninja as you fight to reclaim his home.

pages.title: Sort Photograph
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Drag and swap pieces to rebuild a picture in Sort Photograph. Look at how the image details align before moving a piece. Clear puzzles to earn coins, then spend them on backgrounds or frames.

pages.title: Slap & Run
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Slap pedestrians as you race down the sidewalk in Slap & Run. Each hit adds another person to the crowd chasing you. Keep out of reach by dodging obstacles and projectiles that can slow your escape.

pages.title: Stickman Home Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search the house for a way out in Stickman Home Escape. Look for useful items and decide what to do with what you find. Your choices can change how the escape unfolds, so think before making the next move.

pages.title: Hidden Cats: Detective Agency
pages.creator: MOBASO
pages.description: Find missing cats as Faye in Hidden Cats: Detective Agency. Team up with Carrot to search Shanghai bars, Japanese alleyways, and other scenes. Find the cats before your rival to solve cases and earn gold.

pages.title: Anime Couple Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Choose one of four couples in Anime Couple Dress Up and style both characters on the same screen. Browse more than 250 pieces, including clothes and accessories for dates and weddings. Take a screenshot when you want to keep a finished look.

pages.title: Money Land
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Collect cash and buy your first property in Money Land. Unlock shops, banks, restaurants, and other venues that help bring in more money. Put those earnings back into the town and decide where to invest next.

pages.title: Coloring Book PlayTime
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a Playtime picture in Coloring Book PlayTime. Choose colors for its details and fill in the illustration at your own pace. Try a different palette or move on to another drawing when you want something new to color.

pages.title: Gunfighter Gunmans Proof
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Play a gunslinger trying to rescue his fiancée in Gunfighter Gunmans Proof. Follow the kidnapper and fight through the henchmen he sends to stop you. Watch for enemies as you make your way toward the rescue.

pages.title: Do Not Fall Online
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Stay on a disappearing floor in Do Not Fall Online. Keep moving from one tile to the next and look for a route before the surface gives way beneath you. Try to outlast the other players on the platform.

pages.title: Hammer Flight
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Swing different hammers in the multiplayer arena of Hammer Flight. Land blows while keeping your own barrel from breaking. Win battles to climb the ranks and use the money and bonuses you earn to build up your equipment.

pages.title: Sneak Out 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Help Blue slip past surveillance in Sneak Out 3D. Watch for a moment when nobody is looking, then move through the open route. Stay quiet when you can and make a quick exit when there's a chance to get away.

pages.title: Doomsday Hero
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Help survivors fight zombies in Doomsday Hero. Use weapons, skills, and items to fend off enemies after a chemical disaster. Spend what you earn on stronger weapons and better mounts before facing the next group.

pages.title: Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: ConteZero
pages.description: Build four foundations from ace to king in Klondike Solitaire. Move cards between the columns in descending order and alternating colors to uncover hidden cards. Draw from the stock when the cards on the table don't give you a useful move.

pages.title: White Dot
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Shoot white balls into the circle at the top of the screen in White Dot. Wait until the moving pink ball leaves a clear path, then take your shot. Time each launch to get as many balls into the target as you can.

pages.title: Team Kaboom
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Blast enemies as they move through the field in Team Kaboom. Keep your soldier alive and try to stop opponents before they get away. Escaped enemies return faster and stronger, so watch for them as you line up the next shot.

pages.title: Jumping Box
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fire balls to move a block in Jumping Box. Use the push from each shot to send the block where you want it to go. Work out the right direction and get it to the red flag to finish the stage.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Leg Injury
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Baby Hazel after she hurts her leg playing with Bruno. Pitch in with first aid at home, then accompany Hazel and her mom to the clinic. Follow the doctor's treatment so Hazel can get back to walking and playing.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Christmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Put together holiday pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Christmas. Choose an image and set the grid size to change how many pieces you work with. Look at the outlines and Christmas details to see where the pieces fit, then try to improve your time.

pages.title: Galaxy Defense
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Intercept meteors with a shield orbiting your ship in Galaxy Defense. Tap to reverse the shield and hold to speed it up when a meteor approaches quickly. Extra shields can absorb hits, and finishing a level gives you more protection for the next one.

pages.title: Truck Drift
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose your starting speed in Truck Drift and keep the truck sliding around the circuit. Try a slower run while you get used to the turns or increase the speed for a harder drive. See how many laps you can make before crashing.

pages.title: Dino Run Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Run with a dinosaur and collect food in Dino Run Adventure. Watch the route ahead as you guide the dinosaur toward pickups. Keep the run going and try to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Mahjong Link
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear numbered tiles in Mahjong Link. Look for two with the same design and a free side, then remove the pair to open up more choices. Use the numbers to tell similar-looking tiles apart.

pages.title: Wordie
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Read the clue and rearrange the letters in Wordie. Try a different order when the letters don't form a word that fits the description. Work through the clues and see how many words you can put together.

pages.title: Space Brickout
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Bounce a ball into bricks in Space Brickout. Keep the ball in play as you clear the layouts and deal with obstacles. Work through ten stages as the space-themed boards change.

pages.title: Happy Mothers Day 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild Mother's Day pictures in Happy Mothers Day 2020 Puzzle. Choose one of six images and play with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use colors and picture details to work out which pieces fit together.

pages.title: Twins Punk Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Style twin sisters Mia and Bella in Twins Punk Fashion. Browse their clothes and accessories and put together a punk look for each one. Try different pairings to give the sisters distinct outfits with the same theme.

pages.title: Agile Driver
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Collect coins and steer past hazards in Agile Driver. Look for an open route before moving toward the next pickup. Keep the drive going to build your score and see whether you can beat your best run.

pages.title: Hook and Rings
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Rotate a hook to slide the rings off in Hook and Rings. Turn it slowly and watch where each ring moves before changing the angle. Drop every ring into the hole to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Math Skill Puzzle
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Work through arithmetic problems in Math Skill Puzzle. Read the calculation and use the mouse to choose the answer that fits. Keep checking each result as the game moves between different kinds of number problems.

pages.title: Lovely Puppy Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles to restore a puppy picture in Lovely Puppy Slide. Pick one of three images and a mode, then move the pieces until the details line up. Try a different layout when you want to solve the picture again.

pages.title: Two Punk Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race through buildings and across elevated roads in Two Punk Racing. Beat the clock alone or race a friend in split screen. Try seven modified cars and switch vehicles as you take on the later levels.

pages.title: Knight Rider
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Control a motorcycle's speed in Knight Rider. Accelerate when the route opens up and ease off when you need to keep the bike steady. Work through the courses and see what you can handle at full speed.

pages.title: Candy Blast Master
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Drag a row or column in Candy Blast Master to line up three or more candies of the same color. Clearing one group changes what lines up on the board. Look for a useful match before shifting the next row or column.

pages.title: 3d Billiard 8 ball Pool
pages.creator: LisGames
pages.description: Play stripes or solids in 3d Billiard 8 ball Pool. Pocket every ball in your assigned group before taking aim at the 8-ball. Plan where the cue ball will stop so you're lined up for the next shot.

pages.title: Happy Wheels
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Get a scooter rider to the end of the course in Happy Wheels. Watch for obstacles that can take the rider out and adjust your approach before you reach them. Make it past the hazards to reach the destination.

pages.title: CUBE ADVENTURES
pages.creator: juegocaca.com
pages.description: Collect candies as you explore a 3D world in CUBE ADVENTURES. Find a way past obstacles and solve puzzles to reach the harder pickups. Watch where you step, because falling into the void ends the attempt.

pages.title: Rail Runner
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Run along the railway in Rail Runner. Dodge obstacles and pick up coins as the route gets harder. Spend your earnings to improve power-ups and work through achievements while you try for a new distance record.

pages.title: Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight enemies in a blocky world in Poligon War Zombie Apocalypse. Use the guns at your disposal and keep looking for enemies around the area. Clear the opposition to finish each level and move on to the next fight.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match Christmas symbols to clean the dirty cells in Christmas 2019 Match 3. Locked symbols stay in place, so plan around them and use special pieces to clear hard-to-reach spots. Finish before the timer expires across 16 levels.

pages.title: Color Tunnel 2
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Dodge obstacles as you speed through a bright tunnel in Color Tunnel 2. Watch the shape and position of each incoming barrier, then shift toward its open side. Keep reacting to new gaps and see whether you can beat your previous run.

pages.title: Pets Of Funny World
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Match animals in Pets Of Funny World. Look for the next group as the board changes and work toward the level goal. Earn stars as you clear the puzzles and move on to the next layout.

pages.title: Cute Bat Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Color a Halloween bat picture in Cute Bat Coloring Book. Choose an illustration and a palette, then work through the shapes and details. Try another combination when you want to give a bat a different look.

pages.title: Offroad Truck Driver
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Haul goods over rough tracks in Offroad Truck Driver. Keep the cargo on board until you reach the delivery point. Use the money from completed jobs to improve your truck, buy another one, or open more maps.

pages.title: Racing Beast Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild car pictures in Racing Beast Puzzle. Look for details that tell you where each piece belongs, then fit the image back together. There is no timer, so take your time working out the parts that look alike.

pages.title: Fish World Match
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Match fish of the same kind in Fish World Match. Look for groups of three or more and see how clearing them changes the underwater board. Check the fish that remain before choosing your next move.

pages.title: EG Mad Shark
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Guide a shark through hazards in EG Mad Shark. Collect fish, stars, and useful pickups while destroying mines, missiles, submarines, and radioactive barrels. Keep an eye out for life pickups and upgrades as you work through the threats.

pages.title: Leo The Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together pictures of Leo in Leo The Truck Jigsaw. Choose one of five images and play with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Use details from the truck and its surroundings to work out where each piece goes.

pages.title: Plow Jeep Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive a jeep through snowy courses in Plow Jeep Simulator. Follow the checkpoints and adjust your speed on bends. Steer with WASD, use Space for the handbrake, and change the camera with C. Try another jeep as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Lordz2.io
pages.creator: Spinbot
pages.description: Raise an army and expand your kingdom in Lordz2.io. Conquer territory, build walls around your base, and add buildings to unlock more troops. Use cavalry, formations, and heroes with special powers when you take the fight to other players.

pages.title: EG Tank Defender
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Defend your territory in EG Tank Defender. Aim at enemy planes and their bombs while keeping the tank out of danger. Watch for crates dropped by friendly cargo planes and pick up supplies to help you hold out longer.

pages.title: Dangerous Water
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Guide a princess past obstacles in Dangerous Water. Use the direction keys or tap the screen to move through each stretch. Watch what's ahead and work your way back to the castle.

pages.title: Hit Targets Shooting 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Practice long-range shots in Hit Targets Shooting 2. Use the mouse to aim at objects such as bottles and watermelons, then fire when you have the target lined up. Hit the targets in each layout to move on.

pages.title: EG Horor Halloween
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Catch falling chocolate as the boy in EG Horor Halloween. Stay away from poison bottles and get to each piece of chocolate before it hits the ground. Missing three pieces ends the run, and the objects fall faster as you go.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a spinner drawing in Fidget Spinner Coloring Book. Pick a brush color and fill in the design, using different colors on its parts. Try a new palette or choose another spinner when you want a different picture.

pages.title: Fire Runner
pages.creator: NullMoon
pages.description: Jump between platforms to recover stolen stars in Fire Runner. Watch the gaps and time each jump so you can keep moving. Collect the stars you can reach safely and see how high you can push your score in the endless run.

pages.title: Lost Pyramid
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Explore a pyramid with a friend in Lost Pyramid. Collect gems and avoid mummies and traps as you look for a way to meet up. Use wall jumps to climb vertical passages and check the minimap to see where the other explorer is.

pages.title: Block Crush
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Time your clicks to crush blocks in Block Crush. Watch the blocks move and strike when one reaches the right spot. Keep an eye on changes in the sequence as you try to raise your score.

pages.title: Starship Runner
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer a spacecraft around obstacles in Starship Runner. Watch the route ahead and move through openings as they come up. Collect coins and try different looks for your ship as you aim for a longer run.

pages.title: Pony Girl Hair Salon
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style Lyna's friends in Pony Girl Hair Salon. Start by combing, coloring, washing, and drying Carissa's hair. Curl it and finish it in a long braid before moving on to the next friend in the salon.

pages.title: EG Cannon Siege
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Aim a cannon at the enemies in EG Cannon Siege. Look at where each target is positioned and line up a shot to knock it down. Clear every enemy to advance to another layout and see how far you can get.

pages.title: Back 2 School Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Finish Lina's school look in Back 2 School Hairstyles. Her skirt, shirt, sweater, and tie are ready, so help with the hairstyle before she sees her classmates again. Choose a look that goes with the outfit she picked.

pages.title: Real Car Parking
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Steer a car into the marked space in Real Car Parking. Leave room around corners and obstacles, since even a small collision restarts the attempt. Complete parking tasks to unlock other cars and get used to lining them up.

pages.title: Gravity Linez
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Draw a line to guide the basketball into the hoop in Gravity Linez. Watch where the ball is going before you draw and make a path that sends it toward the basket. Keep the ball away from bombs as you set up each shot.

pages.title: Mommy Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help an expectant mother get to the hospital in Mommy Twins Birth. Call for an ambulance and keep her comfortable while she waits. After the twins arrive, help with feeding and changing them before the family goes home.

pages.title: Sweet Candy
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Swap candies to line up three or more of the same kind in Sweet Candy. Check the target for each board and use your matches to reach it. Work through 38 levels as the goals and layouts change.

pages.title: 2 Cars race
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Control both cars at once in 2 Cars race. Watch each lane for obstacles and bonuses and move the car that needs your attention first. The run gets harder with time, so keep checking both sides before making a move.

pages.title: Princess Tandem
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Dress Elsa, Rapunzel, Pocahontas, and Sleeping Beauty for a tandem bike ride in Princess Tandem. Mix casual clothes and accessories for each princess. Get all four outfits ready before Elsa takes the lead on the ride.

pages.title: Dunk Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide the ball through the hoop in Dunk Ball. Watch how the ball and basket line up and adjust before the shot gets away from you. Look for stars as you work through the basketball challenges.

pages.title: Snowman Christmas Challenge
pages.creator: MokoGames
pages.description: Roll and stack snow to build a snowman in Snowman Christmas Challenge. Work on making a bigger snowman for the holiday and see how high you can get the stack. Try again to improve on the size of your last one.

pages.title: Heroes of Myths
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Lead Greek warriors against demons in Heroes of Myths. Fight alongside Hercules, Perseus, and Achilles as you push toward the enemy temple. Choose Hades, Poseidon, or Zeus to support your army while you work to destroy the temple.

pages.title: 8 Gears
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Move the pieces to repair broken circuits in 8 Gears. Look for gaps in the connections and work out which objects can close them. Arrange the pieces so the circuit is complete before moving to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Monsterfy Justin Bieber
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Draculaura give Justin Bieber a Monster High makeover in Monsterfy Justin Bieber. Start by choosing a style inspired by Frankie, Clawdeen, or Nefera. Follow through with the makeover to give him a new look for his visit to the school.
